name: Positive User
summary: Marketing automation platform from the French Positive group, formerly User.com: email, SMS and WhatsApp campaigns, real-time visitor tracking, website personalisation and workflows, hosted in Europe.
best_for: European small and mid-sized businesses that want email, SMS, WhatsApp and website behaviour tracking in one EU-hosted platform, with a modest sending volume and a small marketing team
skip_if: you send large newsletters every week, you want month-to-month billing printed up front, or you only need a newsletter tool and not the automation and tracking layer
honest_knock: Every plan stops at 60,000 emails a year, about 5,000 a month, and the pricing page does not say what more sending costs, so a weekly newsletter to a few thousand contacts outgrows even the €499 plan. The page prints only annual prices, seats beyond the included one or two cost €69 to €199 a month each, and auto-renewal is on by default: stopping an annual plan takes notice to your account manager at least 30 days ahead, with no refund for the rest of the term. The 7-day trial is short for an automation platform. We have not used Positive User ourselves.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-07 on user.com/pricing in a browser render, prices in EUR as the page prints them, billed annually) Positive User, the platform formerly called User.com and now part of the French Positive group, sells a Marketing Suite in three plans. Campaigns is €69 a month billed annually with 1 seat: email, SMS and WhatsApp marketing, the drag-and-drop editor, a library of ready-made workflows, unlimited contacts, up to 60,000 emails a year, up to 6,000 WhatsApp messages a year and 5 active workflows. Marketing Automation Suite is €199 a month with 2 seats and adds real-time visitor tracking, website personalisation, pop-ups, event tracking, a 360-degree contact view, advanced segmentation and AI agents, with 24,000 WhatsApp messages a year, 20 active workflows, 50 forms and 50 landing pages. Customer Engagement Platform is €499 a month with 2 seats and adds product recommendations, web push and the advanced data platform, with up to 120,000 WhatsApp messages a year, 100 workflows, 100 forms and 100 landing pages. Every plan includes up to 60,000 emails a year. Extra seats cost €69, €99 or €199 a seat a month billed annually, depending on the plan. Add-ons: Loyalty Program €199 a month, Sales €59, Customer Service €59 and Mobile App Marketing €59, all billed annually; on Campaigns, forms and landing pages are €29 a month each. A separate Data & Activation Suite for teams of 10 or more users is not priced on the page. The FAQ says monthly billing exists, but the page prints only annual prices; the free trial lasts 7 days with no card, auto-renewal is on by default, and cancelling stops the renewal without a refund.

cost_traps.evidence: Add-ons: Loyalty Program €199 a month, Sales €59, Customer Service €59 and Mobile App Marketing €59, all billed annually; on Campaigns, forms and landing pages are €29 a month each.

compare_with.name: Brevo
compare_with.why: Brevo is in our dossiers too and also combines email, SMS and WhatsApp for small businesses. Positive User puts the weight on behaviour: real-time visitor tracking, personalisation and workflows from the €199 plan, with unlimited contacts but a fixed 60,000 emails a year on every plan. A team whose cost driver is sending volume should price both on its real yearly email count before choosing.
